title: moe-factor-timing v2: A reproducible benchmark for probabilistic regime-aware factor allocation
description: A reproducible benchmark for probabilistic regime-aware factor allocation. The release contains the code, tests, documentation, reference report, and research paper. The raw Ken French factor panel and the Version 1 archive are not redistributed; the repository provides a downloader, provenance metadata, and SHA-256 checksums. The result is a rigorous negative/inconclusive benchmark, not a live trading strategy or investment advice.
notes: The raw Ken French panel and the V1 archive are not part of this release. The code is MIT-licensed; the paper is provided as research documentation. This is not investment advice. Revision 1 (2026-11-17) is a post-publication audit revision of the paper; the archived record is v2.0.0.
